INSERT INTO user_registration_requests (
                username,
                email,
                opaque_record,
                opaque_credential_identifier,
                opaque_ciphersuite,
                opaque_server_setup_version,
                signup_method,
                status
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
            RETURNING id AS "id!"
